The speaker announced support for the Marriage Legislation Amendment Bill 2016 [No. 2], citing rural and regional support from the electorate of Indi, including the Anglican synod of Wangaratta and a 16-year-old student named Harry, and called on the government to legalise same-sex marriage without further delay.

The speaker argued for immediate passage of the Marriage Legislation Amendment Bill 2016 to achieve marriage equality, opposed a non-binding plebiscite as a political tool that would cause harm, and called on Parliament to legislate directly to end discrimination against same-sex couples.
